title: WWDC 2019 Keynote — Apple
summary: Apple's full WWDC 2019 keynote, announcing iOS 13 with Dark Mode, watchOS 6, iPadOS, macOS Catalina, the new Mac Pro and the Pro Display XDR.
why: HN links it as the unedited primary source, for instance for the booing at the monitor stand price and for Craig Federighi's explanation of Find My.
